tagline: Learning to direct AI, not just prompt it.
intro: I'm figuring this out as I go, maybe a step or two ahead. Each short lesson borrows one idea from film and tries it with AI to see what changes. I pick and check everything here by hand. Come along and explore it with me.
tryElsewhere: Try it in any image generator. [arena.ai](https://arena.ai) has a small free daily quota.
inviteAsk: Have an invite code? Generate right here.
promptPlaceholder: Start with the lazy version of your idea, then direct it.
